summary: Central array of "lat, lon" coordinate strings; every task/vehicle references a coordinate by integer index into this array.
range: Array of "latitude, longitude" strings (WGS84). At least the indices referenced by vehicles/jobs must exist.
constraints: Each entry is a "lat, lon" string; latitude in [-90,90], longitude in [-180,180].
businessRules: Referenced everywhere by 0-based integer index (location_index/start_index/end_index); valid index range is [0, len).

location defines: Indicate all the location coordinates that will be used during optimization. The coordinates should be specified in the format “latitude, longitude”. It is recommended to avoid adding duplicate loc…
Each element in location must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: jobs.location_index, vehicles.start_index. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Cost/distance/duration matrices must have consistent dimensions and indices.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: Out-of-range coordinate value -> 400 input validation failed.
testingGuidance: Positive: a small pool of valid "lat, lon" strings, all indices referenced in range.
Boundary: coordinates at the extremes -90/90 lat and -180/180 lon accepted.
Negative-validation: a latitude beyond 90 or longitude beyond 180 -> 400.
Negative-validation: a malformed coordinate string (missing comma / non-numeric) -> 400.
Interaction: Negative: a job location_index equal to len(location) -> 400.
Interaction: Negative: a non-integer index like "first" -> 400 type error.
